name: Broadway Holiday Magic & Times Square VIP
description: Immerse yourself in the electric vibrancy of Times Square during the holiday season. Enjoy prime orchestra seating at a critically acclaimed Broadway production, an insider backstage history tour, and fine dining at historic Sardi's.
highlights: Prime Orchestra ticket to top Broadway holiday production
Guided Times Square & Theater District walking history tour
Pre-theater 3-course dinner with sommelier pairing
Exclusive souvenir Broadway Playbill & holiday gift bag
includedAmenities: Digital mobile pass with instant check-in

name: Rockefeller Center Tree & Ice Skating Gala
description: Step into the postcard holiday dream of Manhattan. Glide across the ice under the world-renowned 80-foot Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree with VIP VIP fast-track access, followed by sunset views from Top of the Rock.
highlights: VIP Ice Rink access + private heated warming tent with refreshments
Top of the Rock observation deck priority sunset ticket
Fifth Avenue holiday window walking tour led by architecture historian
Gourmet hot chocolate and Belgian waffle tasting session

name: Central Park Winter Carriage & Romance
description: Wrap up in cozy fleece blankets for a private horse-drawn carriage ride through snow-blanketed Central Park paths, passing Bow Bridge and Bethesda Fountain, followed by dinner at historic Tavern on the Green.
highlights: Private 50-minute horse-drawn carriage ride through Central Park
Wollman Rink VIP admission overlooking Manhattan skyline
Fireside romantic dinner at historic Tavern on the Green
Professional 20-minute couple/portrait photo session with digital gallery
includedAmenities: Heated carriage blankets & hot spiced apple cider

name: Statue of Liberty Holiday Harbor Cruise
description: Embark on an unforgettable holiday harbor voyage aboard a glass-enclosed, climate-controlled yacht. Take in breathtaking skyline vistas of Lower Manhattan and glide right up to the illuminated Statue of Liberty.
highlights: 2.5-hour evening cruise aboard luxury glass-atrium yacht
Live acoustic holiday jazz trio performance throughout the cruise
Chilled champagne welcome toast and artisanal canapé selection
Unobstructed photo opportunities within 100 feet of Lady Liberty
includedAmenities: Heated interior salon and outdoor observation decks
Full premium open bar options available
Coast Guard certified vessel with VIP boarding

name: Empire State Building & Holiday Skyline
tagline: Sky-High Views in Festive Red & Green
description: Ascend the legendary Art Deco tower as it lights up the winter sky in festive seasonal hues. Bypass the queues with VIP Express passes to both the 86th floor open-air deck and the newly redesigned 102nd floor glass observatory.
highlights: VIP Express skip-the-line entry to 86th & 102nd Floor observatories
Private audio-visual museum tour of 1930s Art Deco construction
Signature rooftop cocktail at STATE Grill and Bar on ground level
Spectacular 360-degree views of illuminated Manhattan skyscrapers
includedAmenities: Priority elevator boarding at all tiers
Official Empire State Building certificate & lanyard

name: NYC Holiday Family Extravaganza
description: Curated specially for families seeking holiday wonder. Includes premium tickets to the Radio City Christmas Spectacular starring the Rockettes, reserved igloo at Bryant Park Winter Village, and toy flagship store VIP access.
highlights: Family tier seating at Radio City Music Hall Christmas Spectacular
Reserved heated transparent igloo at Bryant Park Winter Village
VIP private entrance pass to FAO Schwarz flagship toy store
48-hour Hop-On Hop-Off festive double decker bus pass
includedAmenities: Covers up to 2 Adults + 2 Children (extra guests addable)
Kids holiday activity pack & souvenir Santa hats
Free skate rental at Bryant Park Ice Rink
